findings.title: Specific waiting period for hernia – portability continuity to be proved
findings.explanation_en: Discharge is Left inguinal hernia treated by Lichtenstein open hernioplasty with mesh. Clause 4.2 excludes hernia until 24 months continuous coverage. Evidence-pack waiting check failed (admission date missing, needs_review). Patient asserts continuous cover since 2022-05-01 with porting in Aug 2025 which if proved would satisfy 24-month wait via clause 4.4 / IN-PORTABILITY, but previous/ported policy copies are missing (F01) and admission date and condition duration are null. Insurer will pend for continuity proof and will reject under 4.2 if not proved.

explanations.en: Discharge is Left inguinal hernia treated by Lichtenstein open hernioplasty with mesh. Clause 4.2 excludes hernia until 24 months continuous coverage. Evidence-pack waiting check failed (admission date missing, needs_review). Patient asserts continuous cover since 2022-05-01 with porting in Aug 2025 which if proved would satisfy 24-month wait via clause 4.4 / IN-PORTABILITY, but previous/ported policy copies are missing (F01) and admission date and condition duration are null. Insurer will pend for continuity proof and will reject under 4.2 if not proved.

findings.fix: Attach the F01 continuity set (2022-05-01 onwards + portability letter) plus discharge summary/final bill showing admission date. Ask hospital records: 'Please confirm admission/discharge dates on discharge summary with seal.' You state cover since 2022-05-01 and ported Aug 2025 = ~39 months, which exceeds 24-month hernia wait, so once proved the exclusion falls away. File together, do not file without F01.

policy_cite.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the following listed conditions shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy: cataract, hernia, benign prostatic hypertrophy, joint replacement, gall bladder stones, sinusitis, piles and fissures.

tool_evidence.advocate_argument: Clause 4.2 excludes hernia until 24 months continuous coverage, which is allowed under IN-SPECIFIC-MAX (max 36 months). Clause 4.4 plus IN-PORTABILITY which overrides policy requires credit for waiting already served on porting. 2022-05-01 to 2025-08-01 satisfies 24 months if proved, per ILL-WP-01.
